title: TraceabilityRecord
description: Written by `convert` ONLY for a run that reaches run_state == delivered (FR-051 / FR-072 / FR-077 / FR-084). A run that stopped at the queue, or is resolved_unauthorized, or ended delivery_blocked_verification_failed, emits no traceability record. v2.1 (audit remediation): `human_review_verification_summary` is REQUIRED (null when no applicable decision); `artifacts` may reference the `run_context` (H3) and the `review_authorizations` append-only event log (M2/M4, renamed from the singular `review_authorization`).

run_id.description: Content-derived digest; no wall-clock time or randomness (FR-053a). A re-run on identical inputs re-emits this record byte-for-byte (SC-009).

extraction_candidates.description: One per independent path that ran (FR-060).

run_context.description: <base>.run-context.json — the persisted extract-stage effective-input tuple that lets `review` recompute the current run_id (H3, research §14). Present for any run that produced it.

review_authorizations.description: <base>.review-authorizations.jsonl — the APPEND-ONLY authorization event log (M4). Present iff the run had >= 1 human-review item (FR-077). Authorization validity is `authorized_run_id == current run_id` only; there is no queue-file hash (M2).

human_review_report.description: <base>_review_report.md — present iff the run had >= 1 APPLICABLE human-review decision (FR-080).

human_review_verification.description: The authoritative machine model the report renders from (FR-083/FR-084) — present iff human_review_report is.

resolutions_applied.description: Currently-applicable human_confirmed decisions replayed this run (FR-071/FR-076); part of run_id.

oneOf.description: The run had no applicable human-review decision.

FR-084 summary of the location-aware verification (full detail is the linked artifacts.human_review_verification record). A delivered run always has status == 'PASS' (a FAIL blocks delivery, so no traceability record is written).

reproducibility.description: FR-053b: whether the local LLM backend can guarantee deterministic regeneration of LLM-assisted audit content.
